name: brainstorming
title_zh: 动手写代码前先陪你把想法问清楚的搭档
tagline_zh: 你脑子里那句「做个能自动整理的东西」经不起三连问。它不急着给方案，先逼你说清谁用、什么算成功、哪条路不走。
tagline_en: That vague 'make something that auto-organizes stuff' idea won't survive three questions. It pins down users.
desc_en: Use before creative or constructive work (features, architecture, behavior). Transforms vague ideas into validated designs through disciplined reasoning and collaboration.
why_zh: 它把设计当成审讯而不是头脑风暴：先复述你的原话，再逐条追问歧义，最后才给方案。跳过它。
why_en: It treats design as interrogation, not brainstorm: restates your words, hunts ambiguity one by one, only then proposes. Skip it.
limit_zh: 只在写代码、定架构、改行为这类「要动手造东西」之前用；纯查资料、跑脚本、改错别字它不接。它只产出设计文档，不写实现。
limit_en: Only for pre-build work: features, architecture, behavior. Not for lookups, scripts, or typo fixes. It outputs a design doc only — no code, no.
title_en: A partner that interrogates your idea before you build
